# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.1

This patch fixes the daily mail review boundary. CAREER JOURNAL now reads every message received in each user-selected mailbox during the complete rolling previous 24 hours, without sender, company, role, subject, or recruiting-keyword prefilters. Every new message is sent to Jev first, and stable provider IDs prevent duplicate classification across overlapping daily windows.

Host batches must now declare the actual window bounds, `rolling-24h-all-messages`, `allMessages: true`, and `paginationComplete: true`. Incomplete or filtered batches are rejected before the cursor advances. Sync results also report Jev-attempt and decision-engine counts for auditability.

The workflow remains read-only. Credentials and authentication links stay outside Git, prompts, logs, exports, and backups.

---

# CAREER JOURNAL 1.0.1 中文说明

这个补丁修复了每日邮箱检查范围。CAREER JOURNAL 现在会读取每个已选邮箱过去完整 24 小时内收到的全部邮件，不再先用发件人、公司、岗位、标题或求职关键词筛选。每一封新邮件都会先交给 Jev；重叠时间窗内已处理过的邮件会通过稳定邮件 ID 去重，不会重复调用。

宿主批次现在必须写明实际起止时间、`rolling-24h-all-messages`、`allMessages: true` 和 `paginationComplete: true`。时间窗不完整、提前筛选或分页未完成时，系统会在推进游标前拒绝导入。同步结果还会输出 Jev 调用数和判断引擎统计，方便核对。

整个流程仍然只读。凭据和认证链接不会进入 Git、提示词、日志、导出或备份。
